label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: The Marketplace chatbot reached production: the integration (MT-1626), logged-in user handling (MT-1627) and backend support (MT-1629) are In Prod, and Kannan Elangovan closed QA (MT-1628). On 22 Oct Naman Bapna deployed the PHP 8.2.35 security patch for the PHP2Shell CVEs to UAT and production (MT-1748), after Nagamuni Valluri assessed the front-end impact (MT-1746). In the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615, due 31 Oct) the core upgrade (MT-1617) and eight module subtasks reached Dev; 51 of the 91 subtasks are still unassigned. A V1.3 Marketplace design implementation (MT-1747, due 16 Nov) was raised with no owner. 14 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Kunal Jangid split the v1.2 marketing revamp into design updates for 17 pages plus the header and footer (MR-1392 to MR-1410, due 31 Oct) ; the hotfix to switch the chatbot on in production (MR-1416) passed its 23 Oct due date still in progress. The home page design updates (MR-1381) are in Dev Testing with Kannan Elangovan, and Saurabh Jain started review and deployment (MR-1391). A second v1.2 revamp story with no due date (MR-1411) duplicates MR-1379. Vishnu kumar yadav's Sonar fixes (MR-1365 to MR-1367) are in Dev past their dates, and the Dev sign-up redirect bug (MR-1065) passed its 23 Oct date in TODO; 17 items are past due, up from 15.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 22 Oct Cășvan Marcel raised a CRM subscription remake (USP-4374): 20 stories and tasks for one subscription page, a work queue, the payment map, the contract tab, recurring billing, overdue handling and route removals (USP-4375 to USP-4394), all already deployed to Dev and due 30 Oct. The request-quote wait step (USP-4395 to USP-4400) is in progress. The S1 subscription calculation error (USP-4204) and the S2 backend error cluster (USP-4199) were deployed to Dev; the S1 Document API 502 (USP-4231) is still To Do. Silviu Oltean deployed chat tabs (USP-4300) and the create-a-service-request flow (USP-4330) to Dev. Past-due items rose from 116 to 123 as Communication Hub and team items passed their 21 and 22 Oct dates; the Highest security bug with no due date (USP-4369) is still open.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The live agent console and handoff queue (UC-21) and its four subtasks went to production, and the Marketplace sign-in work for the chatbot closed (UC-235, UC-240, UC-241). The handoff-options bug (UC-391) is Ready for Prod; a new UAT bug, the user's name is lost during agent handoff (UC-393), is in Code Review. Internal knowledge-base and demand-tracking items (UC-27, UC-53, UC-54, UC-96, UC-97) and out-of-scope handling (UC-128 to UC-130) moved to In Dev. The In Prod items stay open past their 21 Oct date, and on 23 Oct 19 of Shivam Dhoundiyal's front-end widget, admin and dashboard items (UC-243 to UC-298) passed their due date without starting, so past-due items rose from 29 to 48.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid is on the verification step of CI build reproducibility (PULSE-280, due 27 Oct). The define step (PULSE-278) passed its 20 Oct date in progress, and the parent item (PULSE-9) and its implementation step (PULSE-279) passed their 23 Oct date in progress, so 3 items are past due. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: Jira does not record whether the 22 October demo took place. Saurabh Jain started end-to-end regression and lead-flow defect fixing (ATLAS-287); the Gmail lead flow (ATLAS-282), agent orchestration (ATLAS-286) and the demo journey (ATLAS-284) are still in progress. Nagamuni Valluri moved the Carbon set-up and UI wrappers to review (ATLAS-36, ATLAS-38) and started the UI shell (ATLAS-37). 267 of the 295 ATLAS tickets are unassigned and 293 have no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: Yash Janeshwar moved the JWT and session bypass assessment (ID-721) and its five subtasks (ID-722 to ID-726) to UAT Testing. The production chatbot Azure Communication Services and Entra permissions task closed on 22 Oct (ID-766, k.kishore), and Gourav Agnani's Socket.IO SSO logout test closed (ID-761). Ankit Sharma started the Node.js upgrade (ID-772, due 31 Oct) and the S2 bug where a deleted account's session stays active (ID-760). Two epics were raised with no owner (ID-770, ID-771). 6 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: k.kishore started Snyk image scanning (IN-1161, IN-1163) and closed its authentication set-up (IN-1162); Sarath Chandra is upgrading Marketplace PHP to 8.2.35 in UAT and production (IN-1184, due 26 Oct), and b.kumar closed public access for the ChatAI agent domain (IN-1174). On 24 Oct b.kumar configured the custom domain for Azure API Management in UAT (IN-1190, done) and started smart VM deallocation for the USP self-hosted agent (IN-1189, due 26 Oct). The Devops copy of the chatbot Azure Communication Services task (IN-1178) is still in BLOCKER past its 21 Oct date, although the Web-Identity copy (ID-766) closed on 22 Oct. The AKS agent migration items (IN-1158 to IN-1160, b.kumar) and the Pulse pipeline set-up (IN-1166 to IN-1168, Shashi Prasad K and Sarath Chandra) passed their 23 Oct date in To Do. 16 items sit in BLOCKER status and 27 are past due, up from 21; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: Shashi Prasad K closed the 404 work (DM-1082) and the H1 tags on 18 pages (DM-1091), and Murali G closed the email spam issue (DM-1089) and the events item (DM-1095). New items: 404 pages listed in sitemap.xml (DM-1097), a broken Marketplace FAQ redirect (DM-1098) and an authorship change on production (DM-1099, due 26 Oct). 27 items are past due.
